correctness.rationale: Direct class-sum multiplication gives coefficient r_X(i)c_Y(j). Summing equality over all Y or all X yields the exact profile criterion. Unequal row profiles force row-separated matching column partitions; equal row profiles force color-pair components that are loops or even balanced pairs. Conversely these forms satisfy closure. Explicit subgroups of S_2 x S_m give precisely all block orbits. The exponential formula is a bijective labeled-component count; independent exhaustive checks through five columns and a recurrence corroborate all finite predictions.

value.rationale: A recent paper introduced semigroup Schur rings and explicitly observed that rectangular bands have more partitions than direct products explain. This theorem solves the full two-row family at once, shows every such partition is nevertheless automorphic, gives exact all-size enumerators, and determines previously uncomputed order-eight and higher counts (e.g. 48 for a 2x4 band, vs 30 direct-product constructions). The categorical converse and structural classification have independent mathematical content beyond arithmetic checks.
